value.binding_requirement: Resolve the receiver record type and select its canonical schema member before reading or writing; ambiguous candidates have no default. For ordinary non-record objects bind the alternate member according to its capability.

value.dispatch_requirement: Honor captured scope, receiver override and wrapper context; this link identifies a declared body rather than proving every runtime dispatch.

contracts.implicit_completion: Absent an earlier completion or propagated failure, complete with an absent value.
